'''Frome Eubarus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Eubarus worked for [[Mothven Star Trading]], where he was a junior member of staff who dealt with personnel. In about [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], he took time off work to go on a two week holiday on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]]. Before he left, he said that he planned spend his time there [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] and enjoying female company. However, while he was away, his identity was assumed by [[Jarett Hurgen]], who used it to trick the [[heroes of Cularin]] into delivering some dangerous cargo.
